name: Alkmenos
description: A proud man who would not bow to Erebos in death and is bowed for all eternity.

description_citations.text: Magic Origins: card flavor text (Magic Origins, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Alkmenos, who refused to bow to Erebos in death, is bowed for eternity.
timeline.quote: Proud Alkmenos, who would not bow to Erebos in death, is now bowed by his own hubris for all eternity.
